content: The reminder system sends a Windows toast notification when a task is due.
Meeting notes capture attendees, decisions, and action items automatically.
Todos can be marked high priority and grouped by category for the day.
The schedule view shows today's time-slotted items in a day or week layout.
Session chunks are embedded locally using a small sentence transformer model.
A daily summary aggregates reminders, todos, and meeting notes for the user.
The agentic reasoning layer classifies each message into an action type.
Retrieval combines semantic search with BM25 keyword search for better recall.
Reminders that fire while the app is closed are reconciled on the next launch.
Todo items retain their completion timestamp instead of being deleted.
